title: Surfing Uncertainty: Prediction, Action, and the Embodied Mind
author: Andy Clark
summary: The book "Surfing Uncertainty" explains how the brain works like a prediction machine, constantly guessing what will happen next to understand the world. This predictive process helps us learn, perceive, and even imagine by reducing errors between what we expect and what we sense. The author also highlights that action, not just perception, is crucial for survival, and the brain’s predictions guide both seeing and doing.
